answer.summary: Will Larson fits writing around demanding work by connecting it to what he is working on, choosing topics that energize him, and adapting his writing time to his life and energy. He keeps it sustainable by avoiding writing he finds draining and focusing on work he can continue doing.

sections.heading: Make writing complement the job
sections.content: He looks for subjects that directly relate to his work, so writing also helps him refine his thinking and improve his performance. He says writing about unrelated topics is especially hard to fit around a demanding senior role; interviews with people connected to what he is thinking about at work can also help him learn and test his ideas.

sections.heading: Adapt the schedule to life and energy
sections.content: His routine has changed with his circumstances: before having a child, he often used Saturday mornings and early afternoons for writing; now he mostly writes at night, which he says is tricky for energy management. He recommends scheduling deliberately and paying attention to energy—if he is not energized, he may not get writing done.

sections.heading: Choose work that stays energizing
sections.content: He writes what he is interested in and thinking about now, rather than forcing topics or writing for a particular audience. He avoids commitments such as fixed-topic magazine work and deadlines when he finds them draining, and stopped an infrastructure-engineering book when it was not coming together. His approach is to write where there is energy and not where there is none, so the practice remains something he can keep doing.

sections.heading: Match the publishing approach to the goal
sections.content: If the goal is simply career advancement, he recommends producing two or three strong pieces, spending time drafting and revising them, and getting feedback—not starting a weekly blog or newsletter. If the goal is sustained writing, his advice is to publish: he says he publishes almost everything he writes and checks before starting whether a piece is something he can write and publish.
